response.query: How to construct a reproducible benchmark suite combining synthetic and real data that captures spatial clustering, demand variability, correlated disruptions, and representative R-failure patterns?
response.answer: Construct a benchmark suite using synthetic data for spatial clustering and real data for demand variability, then simulate correlated disruptions and R-failure patterns. Validate with real-world data to ensure representativeness.

results.title: Student Projects
results.content: - Familiarize with marker-less biomarkers in the Sensory-Motor Systems Lab - Investigate what regions of the human body are essential for capturing markers of painting actions (e.g., markers in the dominant hand that paints, torso) - Conduct a data collection study with participants to collect their biomarkers - Model the data collected using machine learning and statistical inference in collaboration with Scai Lab - Develop “authenticity labels” composed of unique data correspondences of each participant - Document findings and prepare a final project report - - Hands-on experience in real-time signal processing and machine learning with real human data - Collaboration with an interdisciplinary lab at the intersection of engineering data modeling - Impact on the scientific fields of Robotics, Learning, and Signal Processing - Possibility to have co-authorship of the study results published in a scientific venue - If successful, Labels of Authenticity can be used alongside GenAI models for data ownership recognition with the potential to develop a business case thereafter

results.title: Projects and Theses
results.content: - Hands-on experience in real-time signal processing and machine learning with real human data - Collaboration with an interdisciplinary lab at the intersection of engineering data modeling - Impact on the scientific fields of Robotics, Learning, and Signal Processing - Possibility to have co-authorship of the study results published in a scientific venue - If successful, Labels of Authenticity can be used alongside GenAI models for data ownership recognition with the potential to develop a business case thereafter Tasks: • Literature review on ECG classification techniques and image-based medical diagnostics (10%) • Curate and preprocess ECG images from public datasets (e.g., PTB-XL, PhysioNet archives) (15%) • Develop data augmentation techniques for ECG images (rotation, noise reduction, distortion correction) (10%) • Build and train deep learning models (CNNs, Vision Transformers) for image classification (40%) • Evaluate models and fine-tune hyperparameters (15%) • Prepare final project report and present findings (10%) Your Profile: • Background in Biomedical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Health Science and Technology, or related fields.
